name: Fairview Town Center
summary: Fairview Town Center is an expansive open-air shopping destination featuring an eclectic mix of retail stores, dining options, and entertainment venues. Serving the communities of Fairview, Allen, and McKinney, this highly-rated center provides a convenient and welcoming environment for shopping and leisure activities.
demographics: Fairview Town Center serves an affluent suburban demographic in the rapidly growing North Dallas corridor, attracting families and professionals from Fairview, Allen, and McKinney with above-average household incomes. The primary trade area consists of young to middle-aged families (ages 30-55) in master-planned communities seeking convenient shopping and dining options close to home. Visitors typically exhibit preferences for quality national retailers, family-friendly dining establishments, and regular shopping patterns that combine errands with leisure activities in a comfortable open-air environment.
description: Fairview Town Center stands as the premier shopping, dining, and entertainment destination serving the thriving communities of Fairview, Allen, and McKinney in North Texas. This expansive open-air shopping center offers visitors an eclectic and carefully curated mix of retail stores, restaurants, and entertainment venues designed to meet the diverse needs of the surrounding suburban communities. The center's thoughtful layout and attractive design create an inviting atmosphere where families and individuals can shop, dine, and gather throughout the day. With convenient hours from 10 AM to 10 PM daily, Fairview Town Center provides a welcoming environment that has earned an impressive 4.4-star rating from over 3,000 reviews, reflecting its strong reputation among local residents. The center's strategic location at 329 Town Place positions it as an essential community hub, offering everything from everyday shopping needs to special dining experiences and entertainment options that bring the community together.
